description: Landesamt für Vermessung und Geobasisinformation Rheinland-Pfalz (LVermGeo): volcanic hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Vermessung und Geobasisinformation Rheinland-Pfalz (LVermGeo). Coverage: Landesamt für Vermessung und Geobasisinformation Rheinland-Pfalz (LVermGeo). The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about volcanic hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: VBORIS RLP Premiumdienst 2020 - VBORIS 2020 LK Vulkaneifel, bebaut; VBORIS RLP Premiumdienst 2014 - VBORIS 2014 LK Vulkaneifel, bebaut; VBORIS RLP Premiumdienst 2026 - VBORIS 2026 LK Vulkaneifel, bebaut; VBORIS RLP Premiumdienst 2016 - VBORIS 2016 LK Vulkaneifel, bebaut. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
